options.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original adventurous logo identity exploration for CropEvidence titled "FIELD GESTURE". 1536 x 1024 landscape. User asks for much freer hand-drawn graphic design, NOT another polished leaf icon plus conventional serif. Attached website is palette/context ONLY; ignore its existing logo completely. Reference principles studied: handmade typography and spontaneous drawing in Pentagram LenLen (https://www.pentagram.com/work/lenlen), brush-pressure variation in calligraphy. Do NOT copy any existing identity or use an artist's signature.
Create an original sweeping charcoal-olive INK GESTURE symbol: a loose asymmetric open loop that turns back through itself once, with a small detached seed-like ink dot held inside. The loop feels like an agronomist circling a meaningful observation on a field notebook. Strong intentional pressure changes, tapered ends, restrained dry-brush edge. NOT a leaf, eye, sprout, checkmark, monogram or perfect circle.
Wordmark must be CUSTOM HAND-LETTERED "CropEvidence" in a lively confident broad-nib italic hand, dark olive, distinctly drawn letters with variable stroke thickness and a long free p descender, readable and sophisticated like a contemporary independent design publisher. No stock serif font, no wedding script, no generic sans. Logo is the star occupying 60% of board; symbol and wordmark deliberately interact compositionally without hurting reading.
Presentation: warm ivory editorial sheet, asymmetrical rather than conventional three columns. One massive original lockup across center; small clean monochrome repeat at lower left to demonstrate use; right edge includes a blush vertical strip with standalone gesture at large scale. Sparse blue pencil-style construction ticks/short margin underline OUTSIDE logo only. Upper left small clean text "FIELD GESTURE"; lower right small "CropEvidence / identity study". Show SAME mark and lettering in repeats. Refined and curated with huge negative space, no clutter, no photos or 3D stationery, no tiny marketing copy. Palette dark olive #39472C, cream #F7F4EA, blush #F1CCD6, muted blue #CCDFEC. Texture only in drawn strokes, clean backdrop. Original creative symbol with clear silhouette. No numbered option labels.

Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE highly creative ORIGINAL CropEvidence identity direction titled "COMMON GROUND".1536x1024 landscape. User wants freehand creativity and different graphic design disciplines; make a striking CUT-PAPER / RELIEF-PRINT identity, substantially different from brush calligraphy and polished corporate logo. Attached website only gives agricultural business context and compatible olive/cream colors. Do not imitate its existing logos.
Research principles: imperfect organic shapes as a flexible graphic language (https://www.pentagram.com/work/garden-museum), cut-paper economy and negative space (https://www.moma.org/calendar/exhibitions/1429). Invent original shapes, NOT recognizable motifs copied from those works.
Logo symbol: two bold UNEQUAL hand-cut land shapes facing each other across an irregular narrow cream channel, plus a small round sample dot nestled in the channel. Abstract comparison of two field samples; gap is the visual focus. Silhouette strongly recognizable, irregular corners look physically cut with scissors. Each shape contains ONE broad curved carved cut like a furrow; total mark simple, NOT eye, leaf, sprout, book, shield, stacked diamonds, symmetrical flower or CE monogram. Main symbol monochrome deep olive, no detailed textures in small mark.
Lettering: custom chunky hand-cut lowercase "cropevidence" arranged on TWO lines as "crop" and "evidence". Broad confident condensed black forms with irregular soft slab terminals, deliberate slightly uneven baseline and quirky cut-out counters. Not stock serif, not modern geometric sans. Exact spelling. Huge wordmark and symbol arranged as a beautiful bold editorial poster with deliberate spacing.
Presentation totally different: full ivory field, large asymmetrical olive mark at upper left, stacked huge wordmark to right; bottom has a dusty blue horizontal swath with small complete one-color lockup and a flat apricot paper sample card showing same symbol reversed. Sparse little olive ink registration dot, tiny label "COMMON GROUND". No three-column template. Celebrate original imperfect silhouettes; only a hint of relief-print texture at large size, plenty of clean paper, no grunge or stock farm-shop motifs. Palette olive #303A2C, ivory #F7F4EA, apricot #F3CEAD, blue #CCDFEC. Logo itself must work in one color. No gradients, 3D mockups, photos, slogans or numbered option labels. One identity consistently repeated.

Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE entirely original expressive TYPOGRAPHY-LED brand identity concept for CropEvidence, called "MARGIN NOTES".1536x1024 landscape design board. User asks for creative freehand graphic design, not another generic agritech icon. Attached website is only a palette/context reference; DO NOT copy its logo, standard serif, or layout. Research principle: words themselves can become a hand-drawn graphic identity, informed by handmade lettering systems and annotated scientific notebooks; do not imitate any known brand or specific designer.
MAIN LOGO is lettering itself: exact "CropEvidence" custom HAND-DRAWN wide soft-serif letters, slightly bouncing baseline, a playful tall narrow capital C, generous rounded lowercase counters, elongated swooping p descender. The word flows across TWO artfully interlocking lines "Crop" / "Evidence" with clear reading order. Dark olive chunky strokes, drawn with deliberate personality and subtle uneven contour, NOT standard Times/Didot font, NOT brush script, NOT rough cut-paper block letters. Let the p descender curl underneath into an elegant open observation bracket that connects both lines, and dot the i with an original tiny four-stroke hand-drawn annotation star. The bracket and star are part of the lettering vocabulary, NOT a leaf/flower. Keep spelling perfectly readable.
SECONDARY STANDALONE SYMBOL is that little four-stroke annotation star held by a short open curved bracket derived from the p, shown clearly in a small margin. No separate generic leaf, seed, book, field or CE-monogram icon.
Board: large expressive olive wordmark fills center-left on cream, irregular pale blue flat annotation tab behind lower right edge, a small apricot hand-drawn underline and 2-3 thin pencil leader lines in margins. At bottom, a quiet thin rule and small one-line version of same custom wordmark for a website header; at right, a clean olive rectangle with ivory standalone annotation symbol. Tiny clean text "MARGIN NOTES" top left. Sparse, premium independent editorial studio feel, purposeful eccentricity, beautiful hand lettering. Plenty of negative space; logo more important than decor. Palette #39472C #F7F4EA #CCDFEC #F3CEAD. Flat artwork, no shadows, no 3D, no stationery photography, no elaborate scientific illustration, no extra slogans, no numbered option labels. Show one identity repeated consistently.
